note: Workflow graph-change promotion candidates (task 0873, feature D62; ADR-076 amendment). A candidate is shadow-run against recorded real-run inputs and is promoted into the canonical definition or deleted by its named deadline — never left as a standing parallel <name>2.yaml. `verdict` is null while pending and is filled by `bun scripts/spur-dev.ts promotion evaluate <id>`; `promotion check` (spur-check-feature) fails any candidate still present past its deadline, any unreferenced parallel definition in config/workflows/, and (0877 R8) any retired definition with real (non-dry) terminal runs lacking a recorded decision in `retirements[]`.

candidates.rationale: 0920 (D63 R7): remove the model-only resolve-scope grammar hop; the history-anatomy-cache paths command becomes the sole deterministic mode/window/selector owner (identical normalized bounds, fail-loud on invalid input). Primary benefit: one fewer agent.run per run and >=25s off the 51,452ms scope-stage median on >=5 comparable terminal candidate runs at >=80% mapped action coverage. Unknown token/cost deltas stay unknown. Safety floor: formerly valid selectors yield equivalent bounds/target; invalid selectors fail before analyze/publication; no cache/validation/publication regression.

delta.note: resolve-scope removed; enrich/validate (and conditional correct) remain. Canonical currently declares 3 unconditional agent.run states (resolve-scope, enrich, validate) + conditional correct.
